title: Enforce PostgreSQL immutability trigger blocking DELETE and UPDATE on learning tables
context_summary: Founder mandated zero duplication and zero erasure across all AI learning data.
observation: Application-layer checks alone can be bypassed by direct SQL or accidental scripts.
verified_action: Attach BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger raising ERRCODE 42501 on nh_agent_individual_learning, nh_team_learning, and nh_governance_audits plus UNIQUE constraints.
